_comment: The tour (Milestone 5⅞; docs/channel.md §26; Tom's picks on tour.html, 2026-10-13): offered once, on a first visit, by the welcome; then the steps, each pointing at one thing on screen (target: scorebug, layout, side, schedule, audience, info), the rest of the screen dimmed. notice: the step shows an example MOMENTS ticket under the scorebug. coins: shown only while Fan Coins are on (settings.fanCoins.enabled; the tour, round 2, Tom 2026-10-17). phone: the phone's own steps (Tom: fewer), pointing at its buttons in the bands (target: scorebug, buttons the right band, audience, close INFO and the layout); the welcome is the same. infoIcon in the welcome's small print: INFO's own icon goes before the word INFO.

welcome.title: WELCOME TO SCORCHBALL TV
welcome.text: A made-up sport, played live around the clock. New here? Take a one-minute look around.
welcome.small: Or find it all later in INFO, under GUIDE.

steps.title: THE SCOREBUG
steps.text: LIVE means it's happening right now. Between live matches the channel shows REPLAYS and HIGHLIGHTS. The strip underneath is the heat meter: how hot the ball is. It acts as a shot clock.

steps.title: FULL OR BROADCAST
steps.text: This switch (B) swaps the stats and panels for an immersive broadcast view, with the stands and the crowd.

steps.title: THE SIDE PANEL
steps.text: The match as it happens, the table, the top scorers and the week. Select any player or team for their card.

steps.title: WHAT'S ON
steps.text: SCHEDULE (V) lists the whole day. Live matches are marked in red.

steps.title: MOMENTS
steps.text: Everything you watch live counts: goals, scorchers, interviews, whole matches. Each levels up the more you see it, and a ticket like the one in the upper left corner pops up when it does. Find them all in AUDIENCE (A).

steps.title: FAN COINS
steps.text: Watching earns Fan Coins, fastest in live matches and the off-season show. Spend them on chants, flags, the ticker and more, in AUDIENCE (A) under COINS.

steps.title: THAT'S IT
steps.text: All of this is in INFO, under GUIDE (I). Enjoy Scorchball!
